# Numble Daily

> An English-language daily math equation puzzle with an original browser engine, deterministic daily challenge, practice play, and six-character Mini mode.

## Primary page

- [Daily Math Equation Puzzle](https://taskora.org/): Play an eight-character equation guessing game with six attempts, duplicate-aware green/gold/gray feedback, calculator keyboard, and local statistics.

## Content pages

- [Daily puzzle](https://taskora.org/daily/): The date-seeded daily equation and yesterday's answer.
- [Rules](https://taskora.org/rules/): Valid syntax, whole-number division, precedence, colors, and win conditions.
- [Strategies](https://taskora.org/strategies/): Operator probes, digit coverage, result-width estimation, and reverse solving.
- [Scoring](https://taskora.org/scoring/): Wins, daily streaks, time, and separate local Classic/Mini top tens.
- [Generator](https://taskora.org/research/): How candidates are constructed, checked, and selected from a deterministic seed.
- [Practice](https://taskora.org/printable/): Mental equation-building drills.
- [Equation Puzzle Basics](https://taskora.org/equation-basics/): Eight-character equation anatomy, legal guesses, operator precedence, opening construction, and color-feedback deduction.
- [Mini Mode](https://taskora.org/mini-mode/): How six-character speed puzzles differ from Classic play, with compact-board tactics and an alternating practice plan.
- [Digit and Operator Frequency](https://taskora.org/number-frequency/): General digit, operator, and equation-shape patterns for more informative guesses without unsupported percentages.
- [Pencil Notes and Annotation Strategy](https://taskora.org/pencil-notes/): A practical system for tracking candidate operators, digit exclusions, duplicate limits, locked positions, and remaining equation shapes.
- [About](https://taskora.org/about/), [Editorial policy](https://taskora.org/editorial-policy/), [Privacy](https://taskora.org/privacy/), [Terms](https://taskora.org/terms/), and [Contact](https://taskora.org/contact/).

## Key facts

- The original generator guarantees a mathematically valid equation and applies correct operator precedence.
- Daily mode uses the local date as a deterministic seed, so the day's answer is stable on refresh.
- Classic mode uses eight characters; Mini mode uses six; both allow six valid guesses.
- A submission is accepted only if both sides are equal, division is exact, syntax is legal, and there are no leading zeros.
- Game statistics stay in browser localStorage and are not uploaded.
